name: automation
description: Create and manage durable Nexa scheduled tasks / cron jobs (定时任务、自动化、提醒) directly from chat. Reuses Scheduled tasks in Workbench and its existing scheduler; Nexa must be running. Use only for user-requested future or recurring work. List first to avoid duplicates. Preview a five-field cron and explicit IANA timezone before creating; create requires a stable requestId reused verbatim on retries. Get before update/pause/resume/delete and pass its definitionRevision as expectedRevision. Updates preserve omitted fields. An empty allowedTools means no tools. Tools must be in the current registry and approved for unattended execution. Source/project authority comes from this conversation. Creating a task does not mean it has executed. Run history and pending approvals remain in Scheduled tasks; use that surface for Run now. Do not use OS cron, shell sleep, or another scheduling service for this task.

id.description: Exact saved task id for get/update/pause/resume/delete/history.

requestId.description: Stable unique identifier for a create request. Reuse on retries, choose a new value for a distinct task.

prompt.description: Complete instructions replayed at each run.

cron.description: Five fields: minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week.

timezone.description: Explicit IANA timezone, for example Asia/Shanghai. Required for create/preview.

workflowTemplateId.description: Existing enabled workflow template. Default report_brief.

sourceIds.description: Subset of current conversation sources; default snapshots the current sources.

allowedTools.description: Exact tools explicitly needed by the scheduled task. Default [] grants no tools.

requireApproval.description: If true, each occurrence needs pre-run approval. Default false; creation still follows normal tool permissions.

enabled.description: Create/update enabled state; default true for create.

workspacePolicy.description: Default deny_writes. isolated_patch uses the existing Code Ultra single-source worktree policy.

before.description: History pagination cursor returned by the existing workflow history.

limit.description: History page size up to 100. Schedule preview returns at most min(limit, 20) occurrences (default 5), matching the scheduler preview capacity.
